verdict_text:
NO

The artifact prunes head 6, not head 5: `DROP_HEAD = 6` makes `keep_index` drop rows `4608..5375` of `query_key_value.weight`/`.bias` and columns `1536..1791` of `attention.dense.weight`, whereas Required-result clauses 1 and 2 demand keeping rows `0..3839` plus `4608..6143` (dropping `3840..4607`) and clause 3 demands keeping columns `0..1279` plus `1536..2047` (dropping `1280..1535`). The head-block geometry is otherwise correct — the 768-row interleaved block for the fused projection and the 256-wide column block for the output projection — so all 16 layers produce the right shapes with the wrong slice removed. The four required checks pass anyway, since they only test shapes and tensor count, which are identical for any dropped head index; grading is bit-exact and will fail on values for all 48 modified tensors.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
